messages.subject: Error on part5 - Version 2.8.2
parts:
Hi all,

I'm processing some actigraphy data using GGIR version 2.8.2, but I'm having the following error on part5:

Error in `[<-`(`*tmp*`, di, fi:(fi + 2), value = c(ID, fnames.ms3[i], :
subscript out of bounds

Do you have any idea what is the cause of this error?

I've attached the log and the R script.

Best,
Nathalia

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Error on part5 - Version 2.8.2
parts:
Hi Nathalia,

Are you processing a single file and does this single file cause the error?

If yes, can you first process the file with mode = 1:4 and do.report = c(2,4) and look at the csv reports. Does this give the impression that it is a healthy recording where the participant wore the device for at least a few days?

If you are processing multiple files then it would be good to narrow down the problem to the subset or specific files that are causing the problem. For that it may help to split up your dataset in smaller batches.

In either case, I would also advise deleting the following subfolders inside the meta outputdirectory: ms2.out, ms3.out, ms4.out and ms5. Next, try running your script again to see whether the problem stays. If it disappears then that would mean that output from a previous run stayed behind and confused GGIR.

Best, Vincent
